notes.title: Development Update for Magical Princess
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again from the [i]Magical Princess[/i] development team!

We apologize for the lack of progress updates over the past several months, and we appreciate your patience and understanding. With only three core team members, we've been extremely busy handling a wide variety of tasks. Despite these challenges, we're making steady progress toward completion!
[/p][p][/p][h2]Current Development Progress (approximate):[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Game System: 90%[/b][/p][p]The core rasing system is complete, and we're currently fine-tuning various elements such as battles and skill trees.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Scenario: 100%[/b][/p][p]The main storyline, events, and dialogues have all been completed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Illustrations: 70%[/b][/p][p]The artwork covers a vast range of categories, including characters, outfits for dress-up, monsters, items, backgrounds, and event CGs. Although there's an large number of illustrations required, we're steadily approaching completion.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Balancing: 60%[/b][/p][p]We're carefully adjusting various elements, including classes, part-time jobs, battles, skill trees, cooking, items, and interactions with romanceable characters, to ensure a balanced gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Other Tasks: 60%[/b][/p][p]Music production, character voice recordings, and translation work are underway. Due to the massive volume of scenario content, voice recordings and translations are taking longer than initially anticipated, but they're steadily moving forward.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Over the past few months, we've finally begun to see a clear path to completion. We plan to sequentially release more detailed information soon, so please look forward to it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/c188e67dc678cb81155239a8e6508a289979e9fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Preview of In-Development Game Screens![/h2][p]
This time, we're sharing some in-development game screens, including brand-new scenes. We hope these images will give you a clearer sense of our current progress.

Please note that the text in these screenshots is in Japanese, as translations have not yet been finalized. Rest assured, the full game will support English and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/ebb2db7b73ce956bcfedd16047b02a31fb82ad0c.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/51d660b7e5c0a3bd9a44ae8190a7d9d27f41a51f.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/50ec4bc590e6592f5f91594017ed24f684bcfb2a.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/e8f39489eaa3f6b884bf464d551f1f1d9527a5fa.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/43dea0fa2f41748de6ed6d69d62a2d0e7f04701a.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/5233d69758b57e4eb6da47b70ba0f8a5b99098f5.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/9d606e5408276c0198b25f4a172a72c18fbce345.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/8b8afaa25613e23a0b2de6b2dfb40357f0afbed2.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/e3ef9f3f5250ef2947db70efd07af0b9cfb873f7.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/3f98f9efb7887e28337510cd40423101e6bb80c0.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/8ebeeb581e1778b637d398185893d0d7c172928a.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/82b151e36ebe8b5a364afc71c2d1b384ba5d97a4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our entire team is dedicated to bringing [i]Magical Princess[/i] to completion, and we sincerely thank you for your ongoing support.

notes.title: FAQ ─ Answers to Frequently Asked Questions about Magical Princess
notes.notes:
[p]Hello again from the [i]Magical Princess[/i] Development Team!

Thank you all so much for the incredible enthusiasm and thoughtful questions since our initial announcement! We truly appreciate your interest and support. In this update, we’d like to answer some of the most frequently asked questions we've received.

[/p][h3]Q: Is there an ending where the father marries his daughter?[/h3][p]
A: We’re sorry, but there is no ending in which the father marries his daughter. The story and endings of [i]Magical Princess[/i] focus exclusively on the bond between parent and child, highlighting family relationships and personal growth without including romantic or marital aspects between parent and child.

We understand why some players have asked about this—not necessarily from a romantic perspective, but because of a deep feeling of attachment, such as “it’s hard to let go after carefully raising my daughter,” or “no one else can love her as deeply as I do.” We hope players will find fulfillment in experiencing the powerful family bond and parental love that the game offers.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/2f6cd2851ecbf37011d25560debdeab3b0d8a5c5.png"][/img][/p][h3]Q: Can I play as a mother instead of a father?[/h3][p]
A: Unfortunately, playing as a mother isn’t possible. The father and mother characters each have distinctly important roles in the game's narrative, so simply swapping their positions would disrupt the story and weaken character development.

During development, we explored allowing players to choose to play as a mother. However, we found it difficult to preserve depth, narrative coherence, and emotional impact if these roles were interchangeable. We appreciate your understanding regarding this creative decision.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/d2d60dfd29568936c19d5a0f467c303c3e8f3a11.png"][/img][/p][h3]Q: Does the game include romance between female characters (yuri)?[/h3][p]
A: Yes, the game does feature yuri content, including storylines and endings. However, rather than emphasizing physical intimacy, we are focusing on depicting delicate, emotional relationships characterized by heartfelt affection, subtle gestures, and gentle connections.

There are multiple romanceable characters to meet, both male and female. Some characters might become friends immediately, while others might start off on the wrong foot. Each potential love interest comes with their own unique struggles and background. We hope players enjoy uncovering each character’s story as these relationships gradually deepen.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/cc909de11a1db2bb7dc93ac2349583857c2e5890.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/c3485936375db59ba47de3cac44d6e5a4a5408ae.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/5a19433c3f165ef436750f13beca1c229e98a1ac.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/6601099ded390d6faf67fa4c0bb84cb40a0bd3bf.png"][/img][/p][h3]Q: There’s a rumor the daughter hits her father — is that true?[/h3][p]
A: No, there's no scenario planned where the daughter physically harms her father. This misunderstanding arose from an illustration we posted on the Japanese version of X (Twitter). The artwork actually depicts the daughter about to hit a classmate, not her father. Her actions stem from specific circumstances in the story, which we'd love for you to discover as you play the game.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/a319f8e4cf3696456408e4c602c5f0b9ed41b6eb.png"][/img]Once again, thank you very much for your interest in our game. If you have any other questions, please don’t hesitate to ask—we’ll do our best to answer them!

Thank you so much for your support, and we hope you'll continue to follow [i]Magical Princess[/i].

— The [i]Magical Princess[/i] Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Announcing Magical Princess — And the Emotions in a Daughter-Raising Game
notes.notes:
[p]Nice to meet you! We're the development team behind [i]Magical Princess[/i].

[b]We're beyond excited to finally reveal the game to the world![/b]

There's something magical about the daughter-raising game genre. It's more than just tweaking stats — it's about watching over someone you love, helping her grow, sharing in her struggles and joys. It's a genre that lets you live a life alongside your daughter.

Every choice you make, every lesson you teach, gently shapes her future — until, before you know it, her life begins to branch in ways only your bond could have made possible.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/9852efd6289c76b38572291f920f42ebdb9d50ea.png"][/img][/p][p]In [i]Magical Princess[/i], you step into the shoes of a father raising his daughter in a fantastical kingdom. She'll attend school, take classes, pick up part-time jobs, and face all kinds of ups and downs along the way. Her future could hold glory — as a hero, a cleric, a knight, or even a princess. Or maybe she'll meet someone special and find happiness in a quieter life.

Of course, it won't always be smooth sailing. She might stay out too late. She might run away from home. She might even take on some dangerous work. And yes, it's possible she'll grow into someone the world sees as a villain — a dark lord, a rogue knight, an assassin, a thief. But no matter what path she walks, she'll always be your daughter. And that makes her irreplaceable.

This game isn't about raising her ""right."" It's about showing how precious the experience of raising her at all can be. There's no ""correct"" future. All that matters is that you accept her, support her, and love her — just as she is.

You'll share everyday life together, talk through problems, celebrate little victories, push through hardships... and eventually, you'll uncover the truth behind this world.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/84163083b005ad35cfbcf523157ef7d81d6f2e69.png"][/img][/p][p]There's a lot more to [i]Magical Princess[/i] than what we can fit on our Steam page. Your daughter's choices are wide and varied, and not all of them are exactly... virtuous.[/p][list][*][p][b]Skip class[/b] — Not in the mood for school today? Sneak out and blow it off![/p][/*][*][p][b]Shoplift[/b] — Grab what you want for free! Just hope her luck and timing are on point.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Night shifts[/b] — The pay's great... but there might be a reason why.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dumpster diving[/b] — Who knows what treasures lie in the trash? Maybe even rare items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Church visits[/b] — Feel like she's straying off the path? Let her spend some time doing good deeds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whatever she chooses to do, those decisions matter. They're all a part of her life — and she deserves love, no matter the shape it takes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578571/e73d24445eaf77e1b535747712d337229a50da30.png"][/img][/p][p]We may be a tiny team of just three core members, but we're pouring everything we've got into creating the daughter-raising game of our dreams. We hope you'll be patient with us a little longer.

In the meantime, please check out the new trailer we've released, and imagine the days you'll soon be spending with your daughter.

Thank you so much for your support, and we hope you'll continue to follow [i]Magical Princess[/i].

— The [i]Magical Princess[/i] Dev Team[/p]
